proves.claim: next --take --build claims the one open build item, with a submitted review waiting, in a single call that reserves no review.

cli.journeys-next-take.take-build-one-st.why: A fast seat won every two-step build race and claim hit CROSS_OWNERSHIP; one step removes the race (#11942).

proves.claim: next --take --build --wait 1 blocks while no build item is open, then returns the claim once one is filed.

cli.journeys-next-take.take-build-wait.why: A builder-only seat must wait for build work without busy polling or taking a review (#11942).
